weighted AUC (ties 1/2) equals sklearn roc_auc_score(sample_weight) on 25 random cases with ties
chunked (250) multinomial draws equal one-replicate-at-a-time sequential draws; each replicate sums to G
lower> passes iff lower > target; upper< passes iff upper < target; two_sided gives ABOVE / BELOW / NOT_RESOLVED; SE uses ddof = 1

Stage B tie-breaks (worse local, mean, beta, epoch), alias on tie -> TASK_ONLY_ALIAS, U-B failing G3 -> NO_VALID_REFERENCE; exact-integer gate edges (G2 equality passes, G1 = -0.01 passes); trained-control guard; C* order tie-break; J-G min-guard via C* when L-G infeasible; NO_FEASIBLE_NOMINEE
replay reproduces a rule-generated trace exactly; detects a 1e-6 lambda perturbation, a local/joint weight mix-up and the update-at-epoch-20 convention

critic CE from the torch re-implementation equals an independent float64 numpy computation (within float32 null-direction amplification, 1e-3) and a torch nn.Module path (1e-6); an uncentred-logit view convention differs by > 1e-2 (power of the comparison)
one failed clause, an infeasible L-G (claim A), a missing C* (claim B), an invalid reference or a missing seed each make the claim NOT_ESTABLISHED; a task-only L-R reference alone does not
own forward pass + head outputs reproduce a same-architecture predecessor release (nn__s0__U) on DEFENSE_FIT / AUDIT_FIT / INNER_SELECTION rows (r exact, p 1e-12, hard exact; c reported)
commit / push ISO times with offsets are compared to unit file times in UTC epoch seconds

every check passes on a synthetic study tree with hand-designed selection outcomes (alias, NO_FEASIBLE_NOMINEE, FARE per-purpose choice, C* = F, min-guard via C*), LEACE maps, rule-generated lambda traces, numpy-computed critic CEs and brute-force (sklearn sample_weight loop) endpoints with B = 19; 3.5 (inner refit spot check) is expected to FAIL here because the synthetic inner AUCs are designed, not fitted

on the synthetic tree, a corrupted unit file, a runner selection differing from the replay, a 1e-4 multiplier perturbation, a 2e-6 shift of a 6-decimal endpoint, a dropped row in a release row id, a 1e-7 change of a stored feature, a 1e-4 inconsistent track-record gap and a 1e-3 tracking-CSV shift are each detected

lambda_i <- clip(lambda_i + beta (R_i - c_i), 0, 3 beta) replayed from lambda = 0 with the logged R_calib and c from calib__s{k} (c_i = R_i + 0.005), updated at refits 0..16 (the epoch-20 refit is diagnosis only); effective weights (beta/3 + lambda_1, beta/3 + lambda_2, beta/3) joint, (beta/2 + lambda_1, beta/2 + lambda_2, 0) local; base coefficients; checkpoint lambdas = lambda after the last refit before the checkpoint; unguarded arms carry no multipliers

registered gap = mean over kinds of CE(online_j) - CE(fresh_j); best-of-bank = min_j CE(online_j) - min_j CE(fresh_j); recomputed per snapshot / view / row set (CALIB, INNER_SELECTION) from the per-kind CEs in every track record (snapshots -> view -> kinds -> online/fresh -> rows) and compared with the record's gap_registered_*, gap_best_of_bank_*, online_best_*, fresh_best_* fields (1e-7; float32 inputs); a record with no comparable field fails

online critics re-evaluated from captures.pt (step 1, step 761) and final.pt (theta_{T-1}; and the epoch-20 refit critics at theta_T for refreshed arms) with an own forward pass: v_i = [r_i, centred(W_w r_i + b_w)] from the stored critic_head, T(V) = (V - mu) @ W (float32), critic A = 32-unit, B = 64-64 MLP; CE on CALIB rows (DEFENSE_FIT, critic hash u >= 0.85) compared with the track record's online CALIB values. PASS <= 1e-5; WARN <= 1e-3 (float32 rounding amplified ~1e4 along the floored null directions of the view transform); FAIL otherwise
